full_definition: 完整支持仅针对每一行明确定义的能力和适用范围；父级元素/属性的未知部分不自动变绿。

Exact-head CI, independent review, private candidate, human PDF approval and release are distinct. Additional one-record numeric font-weight source audit at 7fc2f9c2b3c6c434bd8832afa7b383e02f3ee750: source/test HTML-to-PDF role selection, explicit font metrics and pagination, two independently authored role-equivalent 64-row examples and strict failure recovery. Only css.font-weight changed; the other 417 full feature records preserve their historical source/release identities. This is source-only until actual CI, independent review, and any release gates are complete. One-record html.hr source audit at 8c1d475e92902572bf38d53cd2f7d0d5c48d2eca: an actual void PDF separator with current-colour paint, scoped CSS geometry, native 44-entry report and independently authored div PDF-byte oracle, pagination and protected-output failures. All other 417 records retain their own source and release evidence. CI, independent review, human PDF approval and publication are separate. 2026-11-01 additive source audit: four LTR-only logical margin/padding shorthand names map to the existing physical layout sides; current inventory is 418 records and 56 accepted CSS names. Earlier references to 52 names describe the historical panel-margin audit. 2026-11-01 additive LTR logical side longhand audit: eight additional per-side margin/padding spellings, lowered to existing physical cascade and real PDF geometry at 03c17c1f4f4b3eff556cb7353f356ca70439f59a; four existing grouped logical-spacing rows updated, no feature IDs added or removed, 418 rows preserved. Native 40-item oracle, source NUnit, budget and failure recovery checked separately from independent review, human approval and private candidate release. Additive one-record css.display source audit at 9762e45dac1907eb77234132c2e14c348aa55264: actual subtree removal before layout, 40-entry independent visible-only PDF byte oracle, CSS cascade, Native AOT text/geometry and protected-error recovery; all other 417 feature rows retain their own provenance. Exact-head CI and independent review must be checked separately. Additive 2026-11-01 source audit at e137e523264d1250702656ee1968c5ff2f61e8fe: bounded list-style-type changes one CSS row and updates the related ol/ul/li descriptions, four existing IDs total, with 418 records retained. css_inventory_note: 当前语义接受66个CSS属性名称。font-size/line-height支持限定相对值；普通块width/min/max-width/padding及p/h四侧margin可用根rem或元素em参与PDF几何、换行与分页；text-indent及letter-spacing/word-spacing支持限定em/rem，字距/词距限0–24pt；div/section/article报表面板除左右非负长度/auto与margin:0 auto居中外，新增上下非负pt/px/mm/cm/in/rem/em或零的真实外框垂直间距，背景/边框不覆盖margin，嵌套与跨页续片不重复外边距；不实现CSS margin collapse、负值、上下auto/%或calc；margin-inline/margin-block及padding-inline/padding-block只支持LTR的1–2值物理边映射；body/列表/表格/图像/内联盒margin仍拒绝；border及img/table/col不接受这些相对盒值；text-align:justify、min/max-width和overflow-wrap:break-word均为限定子集，不是完整CSS支持。；font-weight额外接受数值100/200/300/400/500/600/700/800/900及等值CSS数字，100–500选显式normal链，600–900选显式bold链，实际字体宽度影响换行分页，不合成任意中间字重。；四个逻辑间距简写使用真实longhand盒模型、important/宽域层叠和跨页排版，不支持RTL或垂直书写。；新增8个LTR逻辑单侧属性margin-inline-start/end、margin-block-start/end、padding-inline-start/end、padding-block-start/end，逐边按现有物理margin/padding层叠和PDF布局，非RTL/竖排，不扩展现有适用元素与取值限制。；新增display仅对非列表/表格的常用报表块接受block/none，none整块不参与正文、几何、分页与绘制，但继续严格验证全部隐藏输入，其他display取值/元素均拒绝。 已接纳限定 list-style-type 列表标记（字母、罗马、decimal、disc、none），非完整 CSS Lists。
release_note: GitHub releases 查询为空；用提交快照/已知里程碑追踪，不虚构产品版本。

documentation_drift.problem: 此文档描述原始 stylesheet 增量，已链接后续 box layout 文档；八属性、无转义及未在该增量加入 width/padding/paint 等历史说明不能单独当作当前能力矩阵。
语义章节仍称八属性及 Box Tree 为下一阶段；解析层说明需和渲染层现状分开。
legacy helper 的 important 错误字符串不能覆盖生产 AST 层已支持 !important 的事实。

maintenance_policy: 每个功能稳定ID。规划字段和支持状态分离。
新增或改变行为的PR同时更新对应行、限制和测试证据；合并后记录实际 main SHA。
完整元素/属性和子能力用 parent_id 分层，不把绿色子行误算成整个属性全支持。
缺历史证据的 introduced_milestone / release 留空；不自动回填历史矩阵。
未验证的平台/文字语言标 unknown，不标 none。
语法AST可表示与最终可渲染分开；expected-error不计为支持。
站点 CI 校验数据结构、固定 snapshot SHA-256 和页面行为；不自动重新审计引擎能力。此 JSON 是站点支持数据的唯一来源。
